subject.title: Feature Request: Per-agent agentToAgent and session visibility scoping

question: Which per-agent cross-agent access model should OpenClaw standardize before the linked implementation lands?
rationale: This changes the hard authorization boundary for sensitive transcripts and agent invocation, and current related items disagree on outbound-only, inbound, scoped visibility, and per-capability semantics.

options.title: Approve a narrow per-agent core model
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR with explicit per-agent session visibility and outbound A2A allowlists while preserving existing global defaults and deferring inbound/per-capability expansion.

options.title: Unify with per-capability visibility first
options.body: Pause the linked PR and design one broader model that covers send, list, history, status, outbound, and inbound policy together with the adjacent visibility issues.

options.title: Reject core config expansion for now
options.body: Close the implementation path and keep current global controls plus operator guidance until maintainers want a broader authorization redesign.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow per-agent core model
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR with explicit per-agent session visibility and outbound A2A allowlists while preserving existing global defaults and deferring inbound/per-capability expansion.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the core session-tool security scoping and multi-agent routing history that this decision would extend.
